title: Run HO19 / Winflo Shield shoe-wall rendering

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Run Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Separate attention, identification and detail across retail surfaces so shoppers can read the display at different distances.
strategic_value: A tall running image, small product card and repeated side messages can connect the Winflo story to actual merchandise.
demonstration: A central running photograph stands behind a freestanding product graphic; two mannequins, shoe walls and glazed towers surround it.
practical_value: Assign the hero activity image to the distant view and product details to the closer display.

content_islands.name: Central campaign
content_islands.spec: Place the tall runner photograph behind a smaller portrait product graphic and shoe pedestal.

content_islands.name: Merchandise setting
content_islands.spec: Frame the center with two mannequins and shoe walls.

content_islands.name: Side messages
content_islands.spec: Repeat white product copy and a small Swoosh on the two glazed towers.

reference_purposes.Application: A central running photograph stands behind a freestanding product graphic; two mannequins, shoe walls and glazed towers surround it.
